meta.proposed: The dark theme, the type families (Source Serif 4, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono), conflict-*, neutral-*, line-strong and the measure family are proposals, not values from the repository. See README › Provenance.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. From --paper. Dark value proposed.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels on paper: the diagram card, record blocks, example sheets.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inline code, table header rows and quiet wells. ink-muted stays at 5.6:1 or better on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text and headings. 15:1 on paper in both themes. From --ink.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: intros, captions, footer, labels. 6:1 on paper. From --muted.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only: section dividers, table rules, card borders. Never the only edge of a control. From --line.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen (controls, the provision rule, unanswered findings). 3:1 on surface. Proposed.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: links, primary buttons, eyebrows, focus rings, the mark. Use sparingly; never for a finding. From --blue.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet accent ground: light-button hover, the statement block header, the cover's rule field.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Only the consumer circle of the mark (acceptance). Decorative, never behind text.

tokens.name: accent-soft-on-accent
tokens.usage: The consumer circle when the mark sits on an accent tile (app icon, cover slab).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and strokes on an accent fill. 7:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: ::selection background.

tokens.name: draft-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the draft status banner and the expired finding. 6.3:1 on draft-tint. From the existing expired claim chip.

tokens.name: draft-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the status banner and expired finding.

tokens.name: conflict-ink
tokens.usage: Only for a finding that evidence conflicts with a claim. Rust, not red: it reports a conflict, not a verdict. 6.4:1 on conflict-tint. Proposed.

tokens.name: conflict-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a conflict finding. Proposed.

tokens.name: neutral-ink
tokens.usage: Text of established and within-period findings, and the decision block label. Deliberately not green. Proposed.

tokens.name: neutral-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of neutral findings and the explanation marker. Proposed.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", SFMono-Regular, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero only. Scale down with clamp(3.4rem, 5.1vw, 4.9rem).

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page titles and home section headings.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: 5. Preserve findings and record a separate decision
styles.usage: h2 in reading pages and declaration principles.

styles.name: heading-s
styles.usage: h3. The only place the serif goes semibold.

styles.name: provision
styles.sample: An operator must not claim to speak for another party without explicit authorization.
styles.usage: Declaration body text inside a normative provision. Max width measure-prose.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Someone still needs to say what they stand behind.
styles.usage: Intros and hero paragraphs, in ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A consumer decides what to rely on.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels in accent. Never a full sentence.

styles.name: identifier
styles.usage: Versions, digests, section numbers, finding labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label glyph and its text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline padding of finding labels and inline code.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of compact rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; record block body padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and banner padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between grouped blocks; header nav gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between page sections on desktop; footer top padding.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything by default: buttons, cards, code blocks, banners. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Focus rings and inline code only.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: The app-icon tile of the mark (14 on a 64 grid). Not for UI.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The one shadow: the home relationship diagram. Elsewhere use a line border instead.

tokens.name: measure-prose
tokens.usage: Max width of reading text and declaration provisions. Proposed.

tokens.name: shell-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the page shell. From .shell.
